item.title: The 1969 Fender Jazz Bass James Brown Bought for Bootsy Collins Is Back on eBay
item.description: A historic 1969 Fender Jazz Bass purchased by James Brown for Bootsy Collins is back on the market, carrying decades of funk history and documentation.

item.title: Bass Big Muff Pi 2: Electro-Harmonix Brings a “Lost” Big Muff Circuit to Bass
item.description: Electro-Harmonix launches the Bass Big Muff Pi 2, which tailors the long-lost Big Muff 2 circuit with Blend and Bass Boost controls for powerful, low-end-friendly fuzz.

item.title: Mudvayne’s “Death Blooms” Gets an Explosive Bass Playthrough by Kade Turner
item.description: There are certain bass lines that still hit like a punch to the chest. Mudvayne’s “Death Blooms” is one of them. In his latest playthrough, Kade Turner dives headfirst into that chaos and comes out swinging. Turner is playing a Warwick Thumb through a Gallien Krueger stack, and the combination absolutely snarls. The Warwick delivers that focused midrange grind while...

item.title: Weekly Top 10: Jack Bruce at Royal Albert Hall, Avant-Garde Chaos & New Bass Gear
item.description: Jack Bruce’s Royal Albert Hall performance, microtonal madness from Angine de Poitrine, Bass Gym grooves, and new gear headline this week’s Top 10.

item.title: Alberto Rigoni, Stuart Hamm & Michael Manring Release Bass-Driven Prog Album "Dystopia"
item.description: Alberto Rigoni, Stuart Hamm, and Michael Manring join forces for "Dystopia", a bass-driven prog concept album featuring former Primus drummer Tim “Herb” Alexander.

item.title: Tim Lefebvre’s Bass Groove Shines on Scary Pockets’ “Runnin”
item.description: Tim Lefebvre fuels Scary Pockets’ Runnin with rich P Bass tone, while Judith Hill delivers a powerful vocal over a tight, upbeat groove.

item.title: Bass of the Week: Inside Bryant Trenier’s Upright-Inspired Fretless Acoustic Bass Guitar
item.description: Bryant Trenier’s latest build is a 32” fretless acoustic bass crafted to sound as close to an upright as possible.

item.title: Rush Expand “Fifty Something” Tour Into 2027 with South America and Europe Dates
item.description: Rush have expanded their “Fifty Something” tour into 2027, adding South America, UK, and Europe dates with rotating setlists and two-set shows.

item.title: Alice Cooper Leads Hollywood Vampires in Rio With Duff McKagan Powering School’s Out
item.description: Alice Cooper takes School’s Out to Rock in Rio while Duff McKagan keeps the low end in session.

item.title: Ibanez Upgrades the SR500 for 2026 with MR5S Bridge, Bartolini & Nordstrand Pickup Options
item.description: Ibanez updates its SR500 series for 2026 with the SR500A and SR500N, featuring the MR5S Mono Rail bridge, Bartolini or Nordstrand pickups, and models starting at $699.
